#include <queue>
#include <mutex>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <optional>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

template <typename T>
class BoundedBlockingQueue {
public:
    explicit BoundedBlockingQueue(size_t capacity)
        : capacity_(capacity), shutdown_(false) {
        assert(capacity > 0);
    }

    ~BoundedBlockingQueue() {
        close();
    }

    bool push(T item) {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        not_full_.wait(lock, [this]() { return queue_.size() < capacity_ || shutdown_; });
        if (shutdown_) return false;
        queue_.push(std::move(item));
        not_empty_.notify_one();
        return true;
    }

    std::optional<T> pop() {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        not_empty_.wait(lock, [this]() { return !queue_.empty() || shutdown_; });
        if (queue_.empty() && shutdown_) return std::nullopt;
        T item = std::move(queue_.front());
        queue_.pop();
        not_full_.notify_one();
        return item;
    }

    void close() {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
            shutdown_ = true;
        }
        not_empty_.notify_all();
        not_full_.notify_all();
    }

    size_t size() const {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return queue_.size();
    }

private:
    const size_t capacity_;
    std::queue<T> queue_;
    mutable std::mutex mutex_;
    std::condition_variable not_empty_;
    std::condition_variable not_full_;
    bool shutdown_;
};

    });

    consumer.join();

    assert(q.size() == 0);

    return 0;

class SPSCQueue {
    static_assert((Capacity & (Capacity - 1)) == 0, "Capacity must be a power of 2");
public:
    SPSCQueue() : head_(0), tail_(0) {}

    bool push(const T& item) {
        const size_t tail = tail_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const size_t head = head_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if ((tail - head) == Capacity) {
            return false; // Queue full
        }
        buffer_[tail & (Capacity - 1)] = item;
        tail_.store(tail + 1, std::memory_order_release);
        return true;
    }

    bool pop(T& item) {
        const size_t head = head_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const size_t tail = tail_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (head == tail) {
            return false; // Queue empty
        }
        item = buffer_[head & (Capacity - 1)];
        head_.store(head + 1, std::memory_order_release);
        return true;
    }

private:
    T buffer_[Capacity];
    // Separate atomics by 64 bytes to prevent false sharing
    alignas(64) std::atomic<size_t> head_;
    alignas(64) std::atomic<size_t> tail_;
};

template <typename Key, typename Value>
class ConcurrentLRUCache {
public:
    explicit ConcurrentLRUCache(size_t capacity) : capacity_(capacity) {
        assert(capacity > 0);
    }

    void put(const Key& key, const Value& val) {
        std::unique_lock<std::shared_mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it != map_.end()) {
            items_.erase(it->second);
            items_.push_front({key, val});
            it->second = items_.begin();
            return;
        }

        if (items_.size() >= capacity_) {
            auto lru = items_.back();
            map_.erase(lru.first);
            items_.pop_back();
        }

        items_.push_front({key, val});
        map_[key] = items_.begin();
    }

    std::optional<Value> get(const Key& key) {
        std::unique_lock<std::shared_mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it == map_.end()) {
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);
        return it->second->second;
    }

    size_t size() const {
        std::shared_lock<std::shared_mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return items_.size();
    }

private:
    const size_t capacity_;
    mutable std::shared_mutex mutex_;
    std::list<std::pair<Key, Value>> items_;
    std::unordered_map<Key, typename std::list<std::pair<Key, Value>>::iterator> map_;
};

int main() {

public sealed class SpanRingBuffer<T>
{
    private readonly T[] _storage;
    private readonly int _mask;
    private int _head;
    private int _tail;
    private int _count;

    public SpanRingBuffer(int powerOfTwoCapacity)
    {
        if (powerOfTwoCapacity <= 0 || (powerOfTwoCapacity & (powerOfTwoCapacity - 1)) != 0)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Capacity must be a power of two.", nameof(powerOfTwoCapacity));
        }
        _storage = new T[powerOfTwoCapacity];
        _mask = powerOfTwoCapacity - 1;
        _head = 0;
        _tail = 0;
        _count = 0;
    }

    public int Capacity => _storage.Length;
    public int Count => _count;

    public bool TryWrite(T item)
    {
        if (_count == _storage.Length) return false;
        _storage[_tail] = item;
        _tail = (_tail + 1) & _mask;
        _count++;
        return true;
    }

    public bool TryRead(out T item)
    {
        if (_count == 0)
        {
            item = default!;
            return false;
        }
        item = _storage[_head];
        _head = (_head + 1) & _mask;
        _count--;
        return true;
    }

    public void CopyTo(Span<T> destination)
    {
        if (destination.Length < _count)
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("Destination span is too short.", nameof(destination));
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < _count; i++)
        {
            destination[i] = _storage[(_head + i) & _mask];
        }
    }
}

public class NativeMemoryHandle : IDisposable
{
    private IntPtr _handle;
    private int _disposed; // 0 = active, 1 = disposed
    private readonly int _byteSize;

    public NativeMemoryHandle(int byteSize)
    {
        if (byteSize <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(byteSize));
        _byteSize = byteSize;
        _handle = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(byteSize);
    }

    public IntPtr Handle
    {
        get
        {
            ThrowIfDisposed();
            return _handle;
        }
    }

    public int ByteSize => _byteSize;

    public void WriteByte(int offset, byte value)
    {
        ThrowIfDisposed();
        if (offset < 0 || offset >= _byteSize)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(offset));
        }
        Marshal.WriteByte(_handle, offset, value);
    }

    public byte ReadByte(int offset)
    {
        ThrowIfDisposed();
        if (offset < 0 || offset >= _byteSize)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(offset));
        }
        return Marshal.ReadByte(_handle, offset);
    }

    private void ThrowIfDisposed()
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 1)
        {
            throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(NativeMemoryHandle));
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        Dispose(true);
        GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
    }

    protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
    {
        // Thread-safe atomic compare exchange: ensure memory is freed exactly once
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) == 0)
        {
            if (_handle != IntPtr.Zero)
            {
                Marshal.FreeHGlobal(_handle);
                _handle = IntPtr.Zero;
            }
        }
    }

    ~NativeMemoryHandle()
    {
        Dispose(false);
    }
}

    {

    head: AtomicUsize,
    tail: AtomicUsize,

    pub fn new() -> Self {
        assert!(CAP > 0 && (CAP & (CAP - 1)) == 0, "Capacity must be power of two");
        Self {
            buffer: [None; CAP],
            head: AtomicUsize::new(0),
            tail: AtomicUsize::new(0),

        let head = self.head.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let tail = self.tail.load(Ordering::Acquire);
        if head.wrapping_sub(tail) == CAP {
            return false; // Queue is full

        self.buffer[head & (CAP - 1)] = Some(item);
        self.head.store(head.wrapping_add(1), Ordering::Release);

        let tail = self.tail.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let head = self.head.load(Ordering::Acquire);
        if tail == head {

            requested: index,
            capacity: self.data.len(),

        if start > end || end > self.data.len() {
